setup.title: Set up this Station
setup.lede: Nobody administers this deployment yet. The account you create here owns it.
setup.username_hint: How you will sign in, and the name that appears in the audit log.
setup.password_hint: At least 12 characters. It governs every forest, so make it a long one.
setup.email_hint: Optional, and it stays on this machine — nothing is sent anywhere.
setup.start_demo_hint: A small forest that explains MonkeyLLM by being one. Delete it whenever you like.
setup.start_empty_hint: Nothing in it yet — you will fill it from Ingest.
setup.start_skip_hint: You can create one at any time from the console.
setup.once_hint: Once an owner exists, this page is gone and everyone signs in normally.
